ac:layout-cell.h1: E-Invoice Lifecycle API Reuse and Spain Changes
ac:layout-cell.p: SPEC030 owns sequences, product impact and LIF-G01–08. This reference owns product-call details and examples. SPEC029 owns required behaviour and exact Spain event meanings.

Evidence: FR-LIF01 is the supplied OpenAPI 3.1.0 document, declared API version 1.0.0, received 28 October 2026. It defines one status POST. Subscription, webhook and history details come from INT-LCS02/05 and INT-ERR01; their full contracts are not supplied. No source proves deployed Spain support.

Grey: existing calls and fields. · Blue: proposed Spain work. · Red: unresolved evidence or decisions. Section 1 uses documented France statuses. Section 2 proposes Spain bindings and payloads. Examples use synthetic IDs; response extracts omit metadata. No example is an executed test.

tr.td: Request a status transition. FR-LIF01 defines method, path, envelope and HTTP responses.
Subscribe to status-processing notifications. Guide evidence only.
Prompt a read after processing; success or failure is possible. Guide evidence only.
Read saved status/history, including the matching attempt. Guide/error evidence only.

ac:layout-cell.p: Use service-returned datasetId and e-invoiceId. Confirm the represented business, actor, environment and invoice's original route before a command. Onboarding's connection result does not grant lifecycle authority. LCS-R04/10; LIF-G01/07.
POST /datasets/{datasetId}/e-invoices/{e-invoiceId}/status · operationId: LifecycleChange-Document · FR-LIF01.

tr.td: Production https://api.e-invoicing.sage.com; sandbox-production https://api-sbx.e-invoicing.sage.com. These do not prove Spain enablement.
Required Sage ID M2M bearer JWT (securitySchemes.m2m). The guide also mentions Domain Services tokens; accepted issuers/scopes need confirmation.
Required Idempotency-Key; optional traceparent and tracestate. INT-LCS01 calls both tracing headers required; resolve under LIF-G03.
Required; application/vnd.api+json. Required data.type = e-InvoiceStatus, data.attributes and data.attributes.statusCode UUID.
Optional object with additionalProperties: true. Descriptions name status-specific data; nested fields, required values and country rules are not enforced by this schema.
INT-LCS01 documents optional statusAttributes.lifecycleMetadata.statusDateTime, UTC date-time. FR-LIF01 does not type this nested field. It cannot replace distinct Spain legal dates.

JSON:API lifecycle-change task. data.id is the operation UUID. data.attributes describes the requested status; data.meta carries creation/modification metadata. No attempt outcome or destination-report result is defined here.
Retry-After is documented on 201 and 429, in seconds. It supplies timing, not permission to repeat a mutation.

ac:layout-cell.p: Save the operation ID. The returned Approved label does not establish that processing succeeded. Follow LIF-API-03/04. LCS-R14; INT-LCS05.
FR-LIF01 supplies these nine request examples. UUIDs and shapes below are existing France evidence. INT-LCS01 supplies the field requirements; FR-LIF01 does not define nested validation schemas.
SPEC029's SPFE states and reporting classifications and draft platform mapping own the business meanings and proposed relationships. This table retains exact request UUIDs and payload constraints.

tr.td: partiallyApprovedData[]: required motifCode; optional motifNote, approvedNetAmount, approvedTotalAmount, nonApprovedNetAmount, nonApprovedTotalAmount, currencyCode.
disputeData[]: required reasonCode; optional notes, requestedActionCode, requestedAction.
Optional completedData[]; supplied items require fieldId, fieldValue.
paymentData[]: required netAmount, currencyCode; optional vatRate.
Same payment shape; the guide allows partial or full collection.

p.strong: Payment Sent request body — supplied example:

p.span: These amounts do not establish full effective payment, Spain legal dates or a completed report. The response enum also includes Submitted; that alone does not establish another writable command. Sample reasons PA-001, DIS-001, SUP-001 and REASON-CODE are not qualified reason fixtures. LIF-G03/04/05.

ac:layout-cell.p: POST /internal/events/subscriptions · INT-LCS02.

The guide names resource = einvoice, eventType = e-invoicing.einvoice.statusupdated, dataset/source/audience scope and an HTTPS endpoint. France source examples do not establish a Spain source. Full request/response, subscriber access, webhook security and replay contracts remain LIF-G01/05; no complete payload is inferred.

INT-LCS02 gives type com.sage.network.api.e-invoicing.einvoice.statusupdated. subject is the invoice ID; data.id is the status UUID. Neither is the POST operation ID. The top-level notification id has unconfirmed uniqueness/correlation semantics.

Read the matching history attempt after the event. Finished processing can mean ERROR. Do not deduplicate separate attempts by status UUID or treat receipt as buyer acceptance. Exact correlation remains LIF-G05.
GET /datasets/{datasetId}/e-invoices/{e-invoiceId} · INT-LCS02/05; INT-ERR01.

tr.td: Current snapshot. It has no operationStatus or errorCode.
IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, ERROR: outcome of that processing attempt.
Nullable processing error code; not a Spain external rejection reason.

ac:layout-cell.p: Use saved history to recover a missed notification. Keep the latest successful status after failure. Operational COMPLETED differs from lifecycle Completed and from each destination's report outcome. Full history schema, ordering, pagination, freshness and operation correlation remain LIF-G02/05. This GET cannot recover platform evidence Sage never received; public consultation is separate.

Proposed country binding: assess this mapping as a Spain lifecycle country pack behind the existing API and qualified connectors. Reuse the platform's native action/attribute/rule mechanism where available. The data.attributes.statusAttributes.spfe object below illustrates required inputs; it is not an established pack format. Resolve the Spain binding, business authority and historical destination from trusted invoice/setup context. The caller's eventCode does not grant authority or select an arbitrary country. France payload validation stays unchanged. FR-LIF01; LCS-R04/10/13; LIF-G01/04/07.

SPEC030's country-pack assessment owns the architecture evidence, proposed shared/country/connector split and qualification. Its contract-fit analysis identifies semantic, input and result gaps. A gap may be resolved through existing pack configuration or country/connector code; it is not automatically a shared API change.

The row mapping covers all eight actions and 52 Annex II field/group occurrences. It retains source cardinalities, conditions, literal paths and existing acceptance IDs. Its API keys and XML interpretations are proposals. The logical event rules remain authoritative for required behaviour. SPFE-S02/S22.

blockquote.p: PROPOSED (Solution Design: Samu Coco / Jiaxin He, 18 Nov 2026) — Mapping boundary: SPEC-SEI-029 proposed invoice states owns cancelled, partial rejection and acceptance-by-silence notification. Sending owns invoice cancellation request/response/recovery. These product meanings do not add an Annex II action, UUID, status enum, payload or endpoint to this table. Existing CANCEL* values remain cancellation of reports, never invoice cancellation. Qualify display/result bindings and actual build/provider support without borrowing France values or treating full rejection as an automatic cancellation. SD-CANCEL01 P-1–P-3; FR-LIF01; SPFE-S02 Annex II.

ac:layout-cell.p: The three existing UUIDs below are conditional reuse candidates. Their France meaning does not prove a valid Spain command. For the other five actions, the API owner must register a supported action binding or select an approved contract extension. No new UUID is assigned by this proposal. FR-LIF01; INT-LCS01/03; LIF-G04.

tr.td: Full effective payment evidence and applicable country rules; partial payments cannot trigger this report.
New action binding required; UUID unassigned.
Link to the earlier recipient PAYMENT report.

New action binding required; UUID unassigned.
Link to the earlier recipient REJECTION report.
Full collection evidence and enabled optional issuer scope.
New action binding required; UUID unassigned.
Link to the earlier issuer SETTLEMENT report.
New action binding required; UUID unassigned.
Authorised issuer non-payment declaration; enabled optional scope.

ac:layout-cell.p: The connector maps recipient actions to ebMS Action = ACCOUNTINGCUSTOMERPARTYACTION and issuer actions to ACCOUNTINGSUPPLIERPARTYACTION. Each selected eventCode becomes ApplicationResponse/cac:DocumentResponse/cac:Response/cbc:ResponseCode. Do not mix recipient and issuer actions in one public message. Catalogue §6.8 permits up to 100 recipient states; §6.9 supplies no numeric issuer limit. The product POST remains one command for one invoice. SPFE-S03 §§6.8–6.9; SPFE-S11/S17.

The five new bindings also need defined response status values or an approved response shape; the supplied response enum has no DEFAULT or cancellation values. Check existing consumers before extending it. A cancellation action changes the report result/history; it cannot erase the saved payment/decision fact or withdraw the invoice. LCS-R03/06/07; LIF-G02/03/04.

Use SPEC029's draft platform mapping for statuses with no direct public event and its reporting-action restrictions for public action constraints. An allowed private communication uses its separate contract. LCS-R02/03/12/13.

Invoice context: resolve the following facts from the invoice addressed by datasetId / e-invoiceId. The logical names below are not confirmed ERP or GET response field names. If a required fact is missing, obtain it through a qualified correction/input path before reporting; do not substitute caller identity or current company-master data. These four fields occur in all eight actions: 32 mapped occurrences. SPFE-S02 Annex II; SPFE-S22 I.1–4.

tr.td: sellerNif — seller stated on that invoice
sellerName — seller stated on that invoice

ac:layout-cell.p: Construct the referenced-invoice group for PAYMENT, REJECTION, SETTLEMENT and DEFAULT from those facts: four mapped group occurrences. It is not another caller field. Cancellation messages retain their four required references. The source's cancellation seller-name level differs from adjacent identifiers; qualify the actual hierarchy under SPFE-Q16.

Event inputs: every API key below is proposed under data.attributes.statusAttributes.spfe. Dates are business-date strings in YYYY-MM-DD form. Obtain them from an authorised product fact or qualified saved evidence. Do not derive them from creation/webhook time. Sixteen mapped occurrences complete the 52-row coverage. R means ApplicationResponse/cac:DocumentResponse/cac:Response. XML targets below express the source meaning; they are not executable XPath. Exact literal paths remain in the row mapping.

tr.td: ReferenceDate, selector ShipmentDate; malformed source path remains SPFE-Q16.
Source R/cac:Status/cbc:StatusReason=CorrectedInvoice. Logical boolean; XML representation remains gated.
Source StatusReason=NegativeAmountInvoice. Apply the negative corrective-invoice/no-payment condition; XML representation remains gated.
R/cac:Status/cbc:ConditionCode: exact "01" commercial rejection or "02" private consumption/not related to business activity.
ReferenceDate, selector DueDate; PAYMENT's requiredness does not apply.
Source R/cac:Status/cac:Condition/cbc:AttributeID=FinancingArrangement; XML value representation remains gated.
R/cbc:EffectiveDate — due date, not the non-payment observation date.

ac:layout-cell.p: SPFE-S02 Annex II pp. 36–42 / SPFE-S22 pp. 4–14 support these field meanings and cardinalities. The proposed boolean keys do not settle indicator serialization or mean that false must be written to XML. Omit non-applicable indicators; hold serialization until the selected schema/fixtures resolve SPFE-Q16. No generic prepaid field is introduced.
Two proposed control inputs sit outside the 52 source rows:

tr.td: One of §2.1's eight exact codes. It must agree with the qualified statusCode, country binding and authorised actor before mutation. It maps to R/cbc:ResponseCode.
originalReportId / opaque string, required for CANCEL*

Resolve the saved report for the same invoice, actor, destination and original event. Keep it internally; Annex II does not establish a wire field for this Sage reference. Check the original result before cancellation/replacement. LCS-R06/07; LIF-G06.

ac:layout-cell.p: For Spain, validate the selected spfe shape and reject mismatched or unsupported fields. France paymentData[] and rejectionData[] remain France contract fields. Do not fabricate net amounts, VAT rows or French reasons to pass shared validation. Public reports carry no partial-payment amount. Separate full-payment/collection evidence and country exceptions must pass SPEC029's rules; supplied dates alone do not prove them. LCS-A20/25; LIF-G03/04/08.

The mapping's business_rule_review links all 28 rules in SPFE-S27 to the existing actions and field rows. SPEC029 LCS-SPFE-R05–07 owns the required behaviour; SPEC030 LIF-API-A09–A11 owns API/build qualification. This adds validation detail, not another command or a deployed schema.

tr.td: Exact saved invoice identity, seller and buyer

The four invoice-reference wire fields stay unchanged. Recipient reports additionally require the correct buyer/represented-party authority. Seller NIF in the reference is not the reporting buyer or authenticated caller. Confirm actual saved/read fields under LIF-G04/07.
SPFE presence, invoice-cancellation evidence and earlier report results

A source invoice record alone cannot prove current external eligibility. Qualify the evidence and duplicate/compatibility lookup; no new endpoint is inferred. originalReportId is internal correlation, not a replacement for invoice references. R05/R07; LIF-G02/04/06.
Invoice type, indicator meaning and original amount facts

Keep 384/471 type checks and corrected versus corrective/negative indicators separate. Resolve BT-113/115 and presence/value semantics before enabling affected rules. Do not add a report amount or a guessed correctiveInvoice field. R06; SPFE-Q16/Q21.

Compare each event's own date using the qualified calendar/timezone and dispatch context. Keep original issue/event/due/receipt values unchanged during recovery. Do not use POST acceptance or notification time as the event date. R06; LIF-G04/06.

ac:layout-cell.p: These context facts are not new caller inputs. Missing evidence returns an owned correction/recovery action; unresolved rules hold the affected report. Existing DTO keys, boolean examples, UUIDs and XML targets remain proposed until the selected country mechanism, accepted ApplicationResponse schema and implementation are qualified. Cancellation does not inherit the original report's event-date fields simply because its code starts with CANCEL.

Use the existing POST path, content type, authentication and idempotency header from §1.1. The blue object is new proposed input. These bodies illustrate a country binding; the supplied OpenAPI does not establish that a deployed build processes them.

ac:layout-cell.p: The invoice references come from saved context. Add receipt dates/indicators only when their source conditions apply. The full-payment fact and reporting obligation must already be established.

Recipient CANCELPAYMENT — non-executable until its action binding is registered:

ac:layout-cell.p: The red placeholder is not a UUID or an assigned API value. Cancellation sends the selected cancellation code and the same invoice references; it does not copy the earlier payment date/amount into unsupported XML fields. Keep the local cancellation link and preserve the business fact.

tr.td: Existing operation reference. Retain it through notification/history recovery; it is not the external report reference.
Proposed read/result coverage: expose a stable report reference that originalReportId can resolve, with its invoice, event, actor and destination. The exact GET response fields remain LIF-G02/05.

Retain exact source/per-item outcomes and external references against that report. Do not invent success/error enums or infer event-response structure from an invoice-submission example. SPFE-S08/S11/S17; LIF-G04/06.
Keep separate attempts/results. An uncertain cancellation holds replacement; known success at another destination stays complete. LCS-A12/24; LIF-API-A06.

ac:layout-cell.p: Public operations stay under SPEC011. Existing DTS is the preferred ApplicationResponse transformation candidate; qualify its actual build, contracts, mappings, rules and operations. API owners must demonstrate the native country-extension mechanism before selecting the namespace/action registry. Validate typed input, response compatibility, retained pack/rule versions and France/Spain isolation. SPFE-S08's pending formats, literal-path defects and indicator serialization remain gates. The proposal does not establish tested XML or production integration. LIF-G01–08; LIF-API-A01/04/06/08.

SPFE report eligibility and result handling use SPEC029 Annex II rules and SPEC011 business/technical error mapping. A rejected report does not create a buyer rejection, erase a payment fact or prove non-execution. Keep rule IDs, resource keys, wire codes and HTTP results separate.

FR-LIF01 lists HTTP errors below. Error bodies use application/vnd.api+json and errors[]; 400 uses the detailed schema, 413/415 include source.header, and the other listed errors use the simple schema. HTTP intake errors differ from later history[].errorCode and external reporting results.

tr.td: Correct the request, method, size or media type. The contract gives no numeric payload limit or complete business validation rules.
Resolve authentication or authority; do not change the business or route to bypass denial.
Check resource identity and access. It does not prove an earlier request had no effect.
Observe Retry-After, then apply qualified repeat rules.
Preserve original request/key/context; reconcile possible effects before an unsafe resend.
Key scope, retention, conflict response and concurrent-transition rules are unspecified. Do not infer them from the header name or invent a documented 409. LIF-G06.

ac:layout-cell.p: Source-quality gaps: the response schema does not require top-level data; its attribute fields are not required either. The 400 example uses links: [] while its schema defines an object. API owners must confirm the intended schema and fixtures under LIF-G03. Qualification checks remain LIF-API-A01–11.
